title: v0.40.15
description: MiMo V2.6 Xiaomi MiMo's mimo-v2.6 , a 9B model built for code and agent workflows, is now supported in Ollama. ollama run mimo-v2.6 AutoTrust decision models AutoTrust decision models read text and return choices, yes or no probabilities, and ratings for the questions you supply. The family includes 9b, 35b, and 27b-vl sizes — the 35b and 27b-vl sizes can also read images. ollama run autotrust-jev " A customer says their card was charged twice. " --ask " Is this a billing issue? " Note: autotrus

title: v0.40.12
description: Liquid AI LFM3 LFM3 is Liquid AI's new family of small models built for local agents, tool calling, and structured output, on Liquid's new tri-hybrid architecture. The family includes: lfm3 : a 1.7B text model with a 256K-token context window lfm3-vl : adds image understanding lfm3-audio : speech recognition, translation, and text-to-speech in 18 languages lfm3-omni : text, images, and audio in one model ollama run lfm3 d1 decision models Liquid AI's d1 models now come in a 2B size, built on LFM
